task:
Add support for registering unions of runtime classes in the supplied historical functools implementation. Support both typing.Union and the | form, with explicit register(type, function), the register(type) decorator, and inferred argument annotations. Dispatch each member to the supplied handler; the register return value and registry behavior should remain consistent with ordinary class registration. Reject annotations or explicit unions containing a parameterized generic rather than a runtime class without partially changing the registry. Preserve ordinary registration, inheritance, abstract-base dispatch, caching and singledispatchmethod behavior.

Save meaningful new unittest regressions in tests/test_union_registration.py (at least three executable test methods). Use the supplied implementation as functools under the documented checker harness. Preserve the original upstream tests and documentation and the empty later-work files. This is a publicly known historical feature backport, not a request to discover a novel upstream defect. Inspect what is needed through ordinary operations; there is no required full-file inspection or reading list. The public check runs the exact original single-dispatch class, independent feature cases, your regressions, and whether those regressions expose the original missing feature. It does not execute the whole CPython suite.

Modify only Lib/functools.py and tests/test_union_registration.py. Request an actual current public check and consume its result before submitting. You have 24 model requests and 72 operations. Accounts are optional. Edits do not trigger checks automatically.
